measurement_scope.map_update: C++ map update calls only; excludes protocol parsing, snapshotting, and JSON/CSV serialization
measurement_scope.map_window_follow: C++ public map window-center update from the transmitted world-frame pose; excludes serialization
measurement_scope.perception: not run; source dataset frames were sent directly to the map
measurement_scope.protocol_parse_and_validate: C++ token parsing and Observation construction; excludes stdin I/O
measurement_scope.snapshot_and_topology: C++ map snapshot plus topology extraction; excludes JSON/CSV serialization

sample_adequacy.note: nearest-rank p95 needs >=20 samples and p99 >=100; short-run tails equal the max and are descriptive only, not SLO evidence

metric_definitions.chamfer_distance_m: mean of the two directed unsquared 3D nearest-neighbour distances in metres on matched common-support bins; lower is better
metric_definitions.completion_fraction: uniquely owned valid reference bins / all valid Uniform5 reference bins; higher is better
metric_definitions.elevation_rmse_m: root mean square vertical error in metres on matched common-support bins; lower is better
metric_definitions.height_accuracy_10cm: matched common 5cm XY bins with absolute elevation error <= 0.10m; higher is better
metric_definitions.latency_frontier: uses map-update p95 only when all four policies have at least 20 samples; otherwise uses map-update p50
metric_definitions.logical_map_bytes: logical map payload accounting, distinct from process RSS
metric_definitions.map_update_p95_ms: 95th percentile C++ map-update call latency; excludes parsing, snapshots, and serialization
metric_definitions.rss_bytes: measured benchmark process peak RSS; includes non-map process memory
metric_definitions.runtime_per_frame_ms: median C++ frame_pipeline latency per processed frame; not perception or renderer latency
